$ ergon --help
Usage: ergon <command> [options]

ergon works on repositories with code in one or more of these languages:

  alpha, beta

Commands:
  init        Set up a repository with the baseline of ergon.
  license     Add and check the license header of every file.
  release     Plan, write and publish the releases of the packages of the repository.
  tool        Run the tools that the sections of .ergon.yaml name.
  completion  Write the completion script of a shell.

Options:
      --flag-debug  Print the value and the source of each option before the command runs.  env ERGON_FLAG_DEBUG
  -h, --help        Show the help.
      --version     Show the version.
[exit 0]

$ ergon -h

ergon: missing command
[exit 2]

$ ergon --version
ergon 1.2.3 (abc123, built 2026-10-05)
[exit 0]

$ ergon init --version
ergon 1.2.3 (abc123, built 2026-10-05)
[exit 0]

$ ergon bogus
ergon: unknown command "bogus"
[exit 2]

$ ergon --bogus
ergon: unknown flag --bogus
[exit 2]
